name: Villa & Palazzo Aminta
insider_take: This Belle Époque masterpiece perches dramatically on Lake Maggiore's shores, where Italian aristocracy once retreated to their lakeside palazzos.
whats_special: The hotel occupies two historic buildings - a 17th-century villa and an elegant palazzo - connected by manicured gardens that cascade down to a private beach. Its position offers unobstructed views of the Borromean Islands, including the famous Isola Bella with its baroque palace and terraced gardens.
pro_tip: Book a lake-view suite during spring when the hotel's ancient wisteria blooms create a purple canopy over the terraces, and the Borromean Islands' gardens are at their most spectacular.
dont_miss: Take the hotel's private boat to Isola Madre, the largest Borromean Island, where exotic peacocks roam freely through botanical gardens containing rare plants from around the world. The 10-minute journey feels like stepping into a Romantic-era painting.
pros: Historic villa architecture with luxurious amenities
Exceptional fine dining with lake views
cons: Limited accessibility due to historic building design
